proposed_from.topic: Exact common-entropy sensitivity for the joint benefit-harm plane with binary treatment and outcome. Define the sharp set Theta_kappa(P) of B=P(Y0=0,Y1=1) and H=P(Y0=1,Y1=0) over factual-compatible latent-factor SCMs satisfying H(U)<=kappa. Prove constructive sufficiency and the exact three-state latent reduction, including an explicit law showing that three states are sometimes necessary for the full image; prove (0,0) is feasible iff G(A;Y)<=kappa and that this origin face admits a two-state entropy minimizer, while I(A;Y)<=kappa is only a necessary relaxation; derive, under treatment positivity where arm risks are used, the zero-budget Frechet segment, the high-budget rectangle, and star-shapedness/connectedness at every intermediate budget. Prove conservative whole-set coverage by exact multinomial inversion. Retain as explicit open strengthening questions a rank-free terminating BH-CERT with nested inner/outer Hausdorff-certified complexes, exact included-cell SCM witness sections, and checkable excluded-cell separation certificates, together with regular-versus-entropy-contact Hausdorff inference; use causaloptim only as a computational comparator, not as a claimed extension. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: For the balanced .9/.1 observed channel, I(A;Y)=.368064 while G(A;Y)=h(4/9)=.686962, so kappa=.5 creates a strict estimand-level false inclusion of no individual effect. Under treatment positivity, at kappa=0 the set is the Frechet line B-H=mu1-mu0; for kappa>=H(A) it is the unrestricted factual rectangle. Replacing each response distribution by a common convex mixture toward one no-confounding response law preserves factual cells and entropy, giving a star-shaped exact set. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove BH-CERT terminates with two-sided Hausdorff enclosures and exact causal witnesses at singular feasible factors with zero latent weights or active entropy equality, without an interval-Newton rank assumption. EARLY KILL TEST: On the balanced .9/.1 law, require one support-at-most-three certified run that finitely separates the origin below G(A;Y) and produces convergent inner/outer complexes exactly at kappa=G(A;Y); pivot if zero-weight/contact boxes cannot be closed.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: {"closest_results":"The closest published results are JiangWeiKocaoglu2023 for low-entropy scalar causal bounds through mutual-information constraints, Zhang2024 for tight binary causal partial identification given the full marginal law \\(P(U)\\), and Pena2023 for benefit and harm sensitivity analysis through separate extrema. KumarLiElGamal2014 is the exact information-theoretic ancestor at the no-effect face.","strict_delta":"The project replaces the necessary condition \\(I_P(A;Y)\\leq\\kappa\\) by the iff condition \\(G_P(A;Y)\\leq\\kappa\\) at the no-effect point and proves strict disagreement on a relative neighborhood of a full-support law. It then identifies the jointly attainable cross-world plane while leaving \\(U\\) unknown and constraining only its Shannon entropy, rather than conditioning scalar interventional bounds on a specified full \\(P(U)\\). The joint plane cannot be recovered by intersecting separate coordinate bounds.","non_subsumption":"Zhang2024's known-\\(P(U)\\) scalar partial-identification theorem does not yield an entropy-preserving three-state representation uniformly over unknown latent laws, while the proposed three-state theorem does not yield Zhang2024's bounds conditional on each arbitrary specified \\(P(U)\\). The binary common-entropy support result does not preserve the additional factual and cross-world moments, the causaloptim papers exclude the nonlinear entropy constraint, and generic interval methods do not provide the required singular causal witness sections. These are the exact proof boundaries rather than differences in notation or estimand labels."}

seed_details.title: Exact joint benefit--harm plane with a three-state entropy factor
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the derivation of the separate sensitivity bounds in Section 2, the identity between average effect and benefit minus harm, and the Discussion were read. The proof boundary is the paper's coordinatewise treatment of benefit and harm.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step replaces separate endpoint inequalities by one common latent response-type mixture that must attain both coordinates while respecting a Shannon budget.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for common entropy with probability of benefit, benefit and harm with entropy, and joint benefit--harm entropy bounds returned no paper occupying the exact target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from response-function enumeration and Carathéodory because all variables are binary.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic enumeration preserves the full-data law only with a much larger support, and ordinary support reduction need not decrease the entropy of the mixing weights while preserving both cross-world coordinates.

seed_details.title: Exact no-effect breakdown budget and strict mutual-information failure
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the definition of \(G(X;Y)\), the finite-cardinality perturbation proof, the binary-alphabet proposition and its appendix construction, and the Conclusion were read. The causal completion at the no-effect point is absent from the anchor.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to prove that \(B=H=0\) forces a product-mixture factorization of the observed \((A,Y)\) law and that every minimizing factorization extends to a consistent SCM.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search found low-entropy scalar bounds and graph discovery, but no exact benefit--harm origin theorem or full-support false-inclusion example.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the definition of common entropy because no effect simply means \(Y(0)=Y(1)\).
seed_details.rebuttal: The necessity is short, but sharp sufficiency requires an explicit factual-compatible causal completion, and the strict neighborhood separation from the published mutual-information relaxation is new estimand-level content.

seed_details.title: Two-sided Hausdorff certification at entropy contact
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the response-function construction and linear vertex-enumeration workflow, and the Summary and Discussion were read. Its certificate is polyhedral and does not address support-changing entropy faces.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is box classification: \(-p\log p\) must be enclosed continuously at zero and feasible preimages must be certified without nonsingular interval Newton steps.
seed_details.destination_search: Targeted searches found interval branch-and-bound and biobjective Pareto-set certification separately, but no certified two-sided image algorithm for entropy-constrained causal SCMs.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from standard interval branch-and-bound once the three-state program is written down.
seed_details.rebuttal: Standard inclusion tests give convergent outer boxes, but exact inner witness sections at zero weights and active entropy equality are singular and are not covered by a full-rank interval-Newton argument.

seed_details.title: Budget-preserving star kernel of the joint region
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Theorems 3.1 and 3.2 on mutual-information programs, the entropy-threshold theorem, their proofs, and the Conclusion were read. The anchor avoids the nonconvex entropy sublevel set by relaxing it.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step keeps the latent alphabet fixed and mixes every response law toward one common no-confounding response law, rather than adjoining an entropy-costly mixture indicator.
seed_details.destination_search: No result was found on star-shapedness or connectedness of a joint causal set under an exact common-entropy budget.
seed_details.rebuttal: The low-entropy feasible set is nonconvex and an external mixture indicator increases entropy; the fixed-alphabet response-law homotopy is the substantive move.

seed_details.title: Direction-indexed support envelopes for benefit--harm welfare
seed_details.anchor_read: The paper's motivation, sharp symbolic benefit functionals, response-type attainment argument, and concluding discussion were reviewed through the published source and the Stage -1.1 record. The exact entropy constraint changes the linear-extreme-point step.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step replaces vertex enumeration by global optimization of \(v^\top(B,H)\) over the entropy factor program and must recover the nonconvex set rather than only its convex hull.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found no entropy-indexed support-function characterization for the joint benefit--harm plane.
seed_details.red_team: Support functions only recover the convex hull and therefore cannot identify a nonconvex star-shaped set.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for a representation-only kernel, so this seed is retained only as a computational diagnostic and not as the proposal kernel.

seed_details.title: Finite-sample whole-set coverage by exact multinomial inversion
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Theorem 2.2 on confidence regions from covering collections, the likelihood-level construction, its coverage proof, and the Final Discussion were read. The causal image step is not in the anchor.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step maps every factual law in the exact confidence region through the set-valued entropy-SCM functional and certifies the resulting union computationally.
seed_details.destination_search: The exact multinomial and causal-set literatures were found separately; no paper was found with finite-sample containment of this entire benefit--harm set.
seed_details.red_team: Coverage follows immediately by set mapping and is too routine to be a headline.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the abstract union, so the result remains a supporting inference rung whose value depends on certified computation.

seed_details.title: Regular-versus-contact Hausdorff phase transition
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the directionally differentiable breakdown-frontier map, Proposition 2 on derivative-aware bootstrap validity, its proof route, and the Conclusion were read. The anchor has no support-changing latent optimizer.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to derive a directional expansion of the nonconvex set-valued map through active entropy and zero-weight KKT strata before applying any bootstrap theorem.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches located generic identified-set rates and directional delta methods but no Hausdorff limit for an entropy-contact causal image.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Fang and Santos once directional differentiability is stated.
seed_details.rebuttal: Directional differentiability is precisely the unresolved theorem; support loss and entropy contact may change both the normalization and derivative domain.

seed_details.title: Inference on the common-entropy no-effect breakdown budget
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, the definition and optimization of Rényi common entropy, the binary causal-discovery theorem and proof, and the Conclusion were read. The paper uses approximate LatentSearch rather than exact breakdown inference.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step estimates the exact binary common-entropy functional at full-support laws and derives its nonsmooth law at factorization switches.
seed_details.destination_search: No econometric inference result for the one-shot common-entropy breakdown budget was found.
seed_details.red_team: The binary formula makes plug-in inference routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: It is routine away from branch switches, but uniform inference at switching and boundary laws is nonregular; standing alone, however, the consumer value is narrower than whole-set inference.

seed_details.title: Conditional-common-entropy benefit--harm bounds with an instrument
seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Definition 3.1, Lemmas 3.2 and 3.3, the graph-specific conditional-common-entropy criterion, the partial-identification theorem, and the Conclusion were read from the ICML source. The paper targets average effects, not joint response types.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step replaces the scalar average-effect program by a joint response-type factorization compatible with the instrument graph.
seed_details.destination_search: No exact conditional-common-entropy joint benefit--harm result was found, but the added instrument changes the declared topic and multiplies the support problem.
seed_details.red_team: A direct substitution of benefit and harm objectives into the published conditional-common-entropy program solves the problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: Joint response-type attainment is not a scalar objective substitution, but the enlarged graph is less feasible than resolving the binary no-instrument kernel first.
